data.action: 认真地揉面团，鼻尖沾着面粉
data.description: 【塞西莉亚 · 面包店学做司康】小镇面包房充满黄油香气的工作台前，塞西莉亚系着大号围裙，两只小手沾满了面粉，正一本正经地揉搓着司康饼面团，小鼻尖上也蹭上了一点白粉——「我也想亲手给劳伦斯烤一次最好吃的司康饼！虽然比例好像有点搞混了……但爱心绝对是加倍的！」
data.promptProse: Cecilia kneads scone dough at the bakery workbench in a pastel-yellow dress and white apron, flour on both hands and a small mark on her nose. Her mint-green hair remains in its usual low braid as she concentrates. The medium portrait shows the dough beneath her palms and baking equipment farther back. Window light reveals flour across the wood and her sleeves, shading the dough's creases between presses.
data.title: 塞西莉亚 · 面包店学做司康
